description: Recent output of a project or AI process, oldest first, one line per entry as [timestamp] [level] message. Works whether it is running or stopped, but DevGlow keeps logs in memory only, so they are gone after the app restarts. Use it when a process exited, failed to start, or behaves unexpectedly. DevGlow writes the logs out on request, so the call can take a few seconds; if they do not arrive, DevGlow is probably not running.

id.description: Project or AI process ID (from list_projects)

lines.description: Number of recent lines to return (default: 100)

name: get_logs
title: Get process logs
